description:
## Finding

`DeviationAddError` at `pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:69` is `pub` but missing `#[non_exhaustive]`. Every other error enum in the workspace (Error in pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-chain-simple, pkix-ac, pkix-ct, pkix-path-builder, pkix-revocation-http) carries `#[non_exhaustive]`. This one is inconsistent.

## Location

```
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:67-74

/// Error returned by [`DeviationStore::add`].
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DeviationAddError {
    /// A deviation with the same `id` already exists in the store.
    DuplicateId(String),
    /// A required string field (`justification` or `authorized_by`) was empty.
    EmptyField(String),
}
```

Compare to e.g. `pkix-path::Error` (line 62) which has `#[non_exhaustive]`.

## Impact

Adding a new variant in a future release becomes a breaking change. All other workspace errors are forward-compatible; this one is not.

## Fix

```rust
/// Error returned by [`DeviationStore::add`].
#[non_exhaustive]
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DeviationAddError {
    DuplicateId(String),
    EmptyField(String),
}
```

## Priority

P3 — API consistency, semver hygiene. Cheap to fix now; harder after release.
title: P3: DeviationAddError missing #[non_exhaustive] inconsistent with all other workspace error enums
